title: Chunk
description: One retrievable unit of a document. Fields follow SDD 5.1 'Chunk', extended with page_spans because a chunk is not confined to a single page.

chunk_id.description: sha256(document_id|chunker_config_id|char_start|char_end). Deterministic: the same file and config reproduce this exactly, so citations survive reindexing.

ordinal.description: Order within the document, 0-based. Presentation only; never an identity component.

text_checksum_sha256.description: Integrity check at index time. A chunk whose text no longer hashes to this was corrupted in transit or storage.

char_start.description: Offset into the document's canonical text stream, not into any single page.

page_start.description: 1-based, inclusive, as a reader would cite it.

page_end.description: 1-based, inclusive. Equals page_start only when the chunk fits on one page.

page_spans.description: One entry per page the chunk touches, carrying the coordinates a citation needs to highlight its passage on that page.

token_estimate.description: Heuristic (characters / 4) for E3 context budgeting. Not a tokenizer result; do not use it for anything that must be exact.

embedding.description: Populated by E3, not E2. Absent in ingestion output.

char_start.description: Offset into the document text stream.

page_char_start.description: Offset within this page's own text, for rendering a single page in isolation.

highlight_rects.description: One rectangle per text line, in PDF points with a top-left origin. Empty when coordinates are unavailable.

coordinates_reliable.description: False means cite the page but do not attempt to highlight. SDD 7.3 makes highlighting conditional on reliable coordinates.
